create.name: Espace Yoga Iyengar
create.bio:
Espace Yoga Iyengar is a studio on Avenue de Cour in Lausanne, led by Gaëtane Valazza, a Level 2 certified Iyengar teacher who has practised yoga for some twenty years. Trained in philosophy and the history of religions, she continues her own studies in Paris in a multi-year advanced cycle with Corine Biria, Jordi Marti and Patxi Lizardi, covering practice, philosophy and teaching, and she assists Corine Biria's classes there on alternate Tuesdays. A second teacher, Léa, shares the beginners' classes.

The room is a plain, open space lined with wall ropes, and the school provides mats and props. Small groups follow beginner, intermediate, advanced and all-levels classes through the school year, with a slower Thursday class built on supported postures held for longer and a Tuesday session for students who need an individual programme. Monthly Saturday-morning workshops each take one area of practice in depth. Gaëtane also leads residential retreats, including a week in the Ourika valley below the Atlas mountains near Marrakech, and a weekend retreat at the Caux Palace is planned for September 2027.

courses.title: Horaires et tarifs (weekly Iyengar classes)
courses.description: Weekly classes at beginner, intermediate, advanced and all levels from mid-August to early July, taken by the term, by the year or as single classes. A trial class is offered and reduced rates apply.
courses.price: Cours d’essai: 20.-; Cours isolé: 35.- (réduit 28.-); Année: 850.- pour 1 cours semaine (réduit 765.-); Trimestre: 300.- (réduit 270.-); Cours supplémentaire: 15.-

courses.title: Ateliers du samedi matin à Lausanne
courses.description: Three-hour Saturday-morning workshops with Gaëtane, roughly once a month, each exploring one family of postures or one part of the body in more depth than a weekly class allows.

courses.title: Yoga et découverte du Maroc (29 mai – 5 juin 2027)
courses.description: A week at a country estate in the Ourika valley near Marrakech, with morning pranayama and posture study, late-afternoon restorative work and inversions, and two days of excursions. Full board, teaching and airport transfers are included; flights are not.
courses.price: 1150 CHF/pers. (chambre triple) à 1815 CHF/pers. (chambre simple, salle de bain privée)
